sn18.6:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Taṃ kim maññasi Rāhula || || Rūpasaññā niccā vā aniccā vāti || || Aniccā bhante || || Saddasaññā || Gandhasaññā || Rasasaññā || Poṭṭhabbasaññā || Dhammasaññā niccā vā aniccā vāti || || Aniccā bhante || || Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasaññāya pi nibbindati || saddasaññāya pi || gandhasaññāya pi || rasasaññāya pi || poṭṭhabbasaññāya pi || dhammasaññāya pi nibbindati || pe|| pajānātīti || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
